negatives.failure: A combined preflight wrapper treated ripgrep's expected no-match exit for AGENTS.md as fatal and discarded drive and worktree results.
negatives.recovery: Run instruction, drive, and worktree probes independently and normalize the expected no-match exit.

negatives.failure: A PowerShell JSON-shape foreach pipeline produced EmptyPipeElement and aborted an aggregate inspection.
negatives.recovery: Assign foreach output to an array before piping it to ConvertTo-Json.

negatives.failure: A second portfolio-shape command repeated the foreach pipeline parser fault.
negatives.recovery: Use a pre-materialized result array and refuse direct foreach-to-pipeline composition.

negatives.failure: A novelty-term probe repeated the same direct foreach pipeline parser fault.
negatives.recovery: Adopt the array-before-pipeline pattern as the preferred Windows PowerShell recurrence guard.

negatives.failure: The first x1 builder correctly rejected a target-trial proposal title at the conservative lexical collision threshold.
negatives.recovery: Replace the colliding proposal with a genuinely different marginal-structural-model surface; do not relax the threshold.

negatives.failure: A collision-diagnostic max operation tried to compare proposal dictionaries when two scores tied.
negatives.recovery: Select maxima with an explicit numeric score key so payload objects are never tie-break comparands.

negatives.failure: The corrected collision diagnostic reached a Maori macron and failed while printing through the Windows cp1252 console encoder.
negatives.recovery: Pin PYTHONUTF8 before process launch and preserve the unchanged Unicode text.

negatives.failure: The x1 builder requested the IANA Pacific/Auckland zone from Python, but the optional tzdata package was absent on this Windows host.
negatives.recovery: Use the configured Windows local timezone and fail closed unless its UTC offset is valid for New Zealand standard or daylight time.

negatives.failure: The first x1 contract review expected a route-mode synonym instead of the exact frozen short-file-pointer enum and returned 32 of 33 checks.
negatives.recovery: Bind the review to the exact serialized route enum; do not rewrite a valid frozen packet to satisfy an unfrozen synonym.

negatives.failure: The retained-negative register used a stale hard-coded projected total after new x1 failures were appended.
negatives.recovery: Derive the projected total from inherited plus current operational plus frozen synthetic counts and assert the arithmetic dynamically.

negatives.failure: The first Git-index privacy review treated the x1 builder's own route-pattern definition as a confirmed payload hit.
negatives.recovery: Classify the exact builder path as a scanner definition while preserving confirmed-hit treatment for every non-scanner path.
